items.html: And the matter is that the correction of ZA now is only through AA, and he is the principal one in this coupling, to bring forth the root and essence of ZON. And behold AA himself is included three within three, and his HGT was not now revealed in him, only his NHY, which rose up to the place of HGT, where AVA are, and rose and were clothed within the HGT of AVA themselves, and then, by the power of those NHY of AA themselves alone, which rose there and were included in HGT, the drop went out, included of their power, by way of the Yesod of AA in the secret of a lower coupling.
